questions.a: Three-dimensional tertiary folding creates active sites required for catalytic and metabolic functions.

questions.a: Enzymes are classified into six categories based on reaction type, requiring non-protein cofactors for full catalytic function.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Enzyme Classification and Co-factors'.
questions.a: Active holoenzyme consists of the protein apoenzyme combined with organic or inorganic cofactors.
